sources.title: GLM-5.3 - openlm.ai
sources.snippet: GLM-5.3 is our latest flagship model for coding and long-horizon tasks. It marks a substantial leap in long-horizon task capability over its predecessor GLM-5.1 and delivers that capability on a solid 1M-token context. It is pure open with an MIT open-source license — no regional limits, technical access without borders.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 - Overview - Z.AI DEVELOPER DOCUMENT
sources.snippet: Overview GLM-5.3 is Z.ai's latest flagship model, delivering comprehensive advancements in complex software engineering and agent capabilities. It uses the same base model as GLM-5.2, with all improvements driven by post-training. sources.title: GLM-5.3 — Benchmarks, Specs & Release Date
sources.snippet: GLM-5.3 GLM-5.3 is an AI model released by Z.ai on Friday, Aug 14 2026, 59 days after GLM-5.2. It is a 743B parameter model. Benchmark results (shown below) cover Terminal-Bench 3.0, ExploitBench, ExploitGym, Agent's Last Exam, AutomationBench, DeepSWE 1.1, and 3 more.
